blocks.text: Andrew Muhlach revealed that his weight gain and the stress it brought prompted him to take a step back from show biz for a while. During an ambush interview at a racing event in Pampanga, Muhlach said he became less visible in the entertainment industry after his weight reached 84 kilos. “I lost 15 kilos. Tumaba po talaga. Kaya medyo nawala-wala din ako. Siguro na-stress din ako. Nag-84 kilos ako non. Ngayon nasa 68 na lang ako,” he said.
